free.label: REFLUX FREE v1.0.22
free.message: Faster startup — hardware detection now runs in the background so the home page and setup tutorial are usable right away instead of waiting on it.

pro.label: REFLUX PRO v1.0.31
pro.message: Faster startup — the setup tutorial now opens right after you enter instead of waiting on hardware detection, which could take up to two minutes on slower PCs. Hardware detection and your auto profile now run in the background so the UI is usable immediately.
